notes: Machine-readable privacy release gate. It records which privacy requirements are backed by a named automated test and which still require deployed/manual evidence. It is not a compliance certification.

An automated row is 'verified' only while its tests[] entries resolve to a real, named test. A manual/deploy row is 'verified' only with an evidenceRef that a reviewer can open; a boolean edited to true is not evidence.

Default `npm run verify:privacy` fails on an unresolved automated row. `npm run verify:privacy -- --release` additionally fails while a required manual/deploy row is not verified. A pending row is not a pass.
Evidence bundles must contain synthetic/redacted data only; secrets are recorded by name, never by value.

checks.requirement: A sensitive operation is refused at the authoritative backend boundary with a typed CONSENT_REQUIRED envelope, no payload, and no side effect when consent is missing, stale, or denied, even when the browser/portal is bypassed.

tests.name: surfaces CONSENT_REQUIRED as a recoverable, renderable state without an OAuth challenge

checks.note: Proves the guard runs before import side effects and that an unwired guard refuses rather than assumes consent.

checks.requirement: Unexpected identifying, debug, or genotype fields in backend responses and WGS inputs do not cross the approved projection on structuredContent, text, metadata, or error paths; only declared response fields and explicitly approved genotype detail survive.

tests.name: drops unknown top-level, nested, and object fields from structuredContent
drops unrequested genotypes and debug fields from list results, keeping search scope
keeps approved genotype detail in the variant evidence tool and drops sample metadata
rejects client-supplied identity, because identity comes from the token
carries the verified client id for consent partitioning
limits a Full miss to the catalog search fields

checks.note: The projection is per committed output schema; a loose validation schema alone is not a boundary.

checks.requirement: Ordinary logs carry a bounded operational schema (tool, status, timing, opaque request id, schema-derived argument names) and never an argument value: no health-history prose, filenames, genotypes, tokens, context values, account identifiers, or data-bearing exception messages.

tests.name: keeps health-history prose, filenames, genotypes, tokens, and context out of the full log
classifies a thrown error without copying its message or stack
records one ordered record per call with argument names but no values

checks.note: Routing argument values appear only in a designated synthetic capture, never in ordinary production logs.

checks.requirement: Identity comes only from the verified token; a subject, client, or argument-supplied value cannot read or mutate another account's data, and grants remain scoped per subject and per client.
checks.note: Covers per-subject/per-client isolation for consent and integration grants.

checks.requirement: Withdrawal takes effect on the next request that reaches the boundary: a withdrawn purpose blocks sensitive reads with no payload, a disconnected integration is refused as INTEGRATION_REVOKED with a recovery hint, and relink must re-accept rather than silently restore withdrawn permissions.

tests.name: surfaces INTEGRATION_REVOKED with a reconnect hint and no OAuth challenge

checks.note: The documented propagation bound is that the fence gates request start; an in-flight request is not rechecked mid-run.

checks.requirement: The deletion fence runs before consent and before any side effect, blocks sensitive reads and imports with typed DELETION_IN_PROGRESS/DATA_DELETED envelopes and no payload, fails closed on a store error, and leaves the recovery import path open after a completed closure.
checks.note: Covers the import/read fence and fail-closed behavior; physical store purge completeness remains PRIV-07 deployed evidence.

checks.requirement: In staging, synthetic new/existing accounts exercise absent/stale/withdrawn consent, import, overview/details, no-match searches, expired tokens, disconnect, delete, and relink, with every response channel and sampled logs inspected for sentinel data.
checks.note: Requires AWS/Cognito and a manual ChatGPT session. Blocked by PRIV-01 C1; the discovery steps are in mutant-mcp/docs/privacy/discovery-runbook.md section 5.

checks.requirement: A release evidence bundle records component revisions, policy/consent notice versions, the approved data inventory, deployed retention/access settings, and deletion/withdrawal outcomes, with credentials and real identifiers removed.
checks.note: Blocked by PRIV-01 D1/D2/D3/D5/D6/D7 and the PRIV-06 P3 retention decision; verify:retention emits the retention half (retention-report.json).

checks.requirement: Observed ChatGPT routing traces are captured from a designated synthetic session so that pending-manual-capture placeholders become observed calls; privacy fixes must not turn an incomplete trace into an observed one.
checks.note: Requires MUTANT_TRACE_CAPTURE=1 in a controlled environment and a manual ChatGPT session (npm run record:trace).
